verdict.rationale: Pipecat (framework plus Pipecat Cloud) could plausibly offer registrable outbound webhooks, so the axis applies. The only webhook evidence is telephony carriers (Twilio, Telnyx, etc.) calling the developer's own webhook for inbound calls. That is a third-party callback into the user's server, not a Pipecat-provided event subscription. In-process turn events and client SDK events are not HTTP callbacks, and the Cloud OpenAPI description lists no webhook registration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
